highlights: Neuron-level functional decomposition and role-aware neuron alignment for RAG

publications.name: RNA-RAG: Role-Assigned Neuron Alignment for Noise-Robust Retrieval-Augmented Language Models
publications.summary: Jaemin Kim, Seo Yeon Park. Proposes a role-assigned neuron alignment method that aligns and adjusts neuron groups contributing to context processing, making retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) models robust to retrieval noise. Published at ASK 2026 and received the NIA President's Award.

publications.name: Neuro-RIT: Neuron-Guided Instruction Tuning for Robust Retrieval-Augmented Language Model
publications.summary: Jaemin Kim, Jae O Lee, Sumyeong Ahn, Seo Yeon Park. A neuron-level functional decomposition framework that identifies context-specific and shared neuron groups in RAG models, applies role-specific summary-based denoising, and performs layer-aware selective adaptation to improve robustness under retrieval noise.

projects.name: Accessible AI Voice Kiosk for Seniors
projects.summary: Team Leader & PM — 2025 AI Convergence Ideathon (Excellence Award). Designed and implemented a speech-to-text pipeline with OpenAI Whisper to transcribe seniors' voice input, then used GPT-4o mini to extract ordering intent and convert unstructured language into structured kiosk orders. Led overall planning and system architecture and delivered the final presentation.
